column1: # Rule: contract (abstract too), library, struct and enum are a class, at file
# level or inside a contract; interface is an interface; a function (free or
# in a contract, interface or library), an event and a custom error are a
# function; a modifier, constructor, receive and fallback are a method; a
# `type X is T;` is a type_alias; a constant or immutable (file level or state)
# is a constant; any other state variable is a field. Struct members, enum
# values, parameters, locals and `using` are not definitions.
